verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own docs say the managed API is offered with US, EU, and Australia endpoints, and that it can also run in-VPC or self-hosted, so users can choose a region or keep data in their own infrastructure. The evidence is a single one-line mention, and it does not say whether choosing a regional endpoint guarantees where data is stored. missing for 10: explicit data-at-rest residency guarantees per region, documentation of how to select or configure a region and what data stays there, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Available as a managed API (US, EU, and Australia endpoints), in-VPC, or self-hosted.
